label: Example provider connector
summary: Document an explicitly selected optional provider integration before any executable package is implemented.
core_boundary: This is an authoring example, not an admitted package. Essential Core features, current actor and tenant authorization, publisher trust and host execution remain outside this metadata. A production provider interface and licensing model must be reviewed separately.
acceptance: Replace the example scope and catalogue key with exact existing design keys and the correct Core owner boundaries before proposing a real package.
Select a concrete provider/interface profile and define positive, refusal, outage and recovery evidence without inventing qualified revisions or artifacts.
Keep credentials in scoped secret references and reject arbitrary shell commands, host paths, network destinations and container sockets.
Retain design, installable false and source model undecided until the separate implementation, trust, licensing and admission work establishes a supported release.
Prove that optional connector outage, commercial entitlement loss and uninstall preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, audit and retained-data recovery.
